"""Main retires reviewed successful raw logs and verified published staging copies."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
F = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/docs-sycl-storage-retention-20261009/bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression')


def identity(path):
    return dict(path=str(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    manifest_path = B / 'latest-update-main-closed-update-retention-v1.json'
    assert not manifest_path.exists()
    root = B / 'latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v6'
    summary = json.loads((root / 'campaign-summary.json').read_text())
    assert summary['passed'] and summary['complete'] and not summary['active']
    entries = []
    records = {}
    for text, digest in summary['individual_receipts'].items():
        p = Path(text)
        assert identity(p)['sha256'] == digest
        v = json.loads(p.read_text())
        assert v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active']
        assert v['model_normal_close'] and v['kernel_gate_passed']
        archive = F / 'receipts-v158' / (str(p.relative_to(B)).replace('/', '--'))
        kept = json.loads(archive.read_text())
        assert kept['original']['sha256'] == digest and kept['original_passed'] is True
        assert kept['receipt']['protocol_events'] == v['protocol_events']
        assert kept['receipt']['model_close'] == v['model_close']
        records[str(p)] = digest
        for c in v['commands'] + v['guard_commands']:
            assert c['exit_code'] == 0 and c['observation_complete'] and c['direct_child_reaped']
            assert c['session_empty'] and c['session_anchored'] and not c['cleanup'] and not c['survivors']
            for name, pin in c['logs'].items():
                raw = p.parent / 'commands' / name
                actual = identity(raw)
                assert actual['bytes'] == pin['bytes'] and actual['sha256'] == pin['sha256']
                entries.append(dict(**actual, replacement=str(archive),
                    reason='Closed successful protocol, progress, mapped providers and fault findings extracted and committed; duplicate full stdout/stderr'))
        if v.get('input'):
            raw = p.parent / 'tokens.txt'
            actual = identity(raw)
            assert actual['sha256'] == v['input']['sha256']
            entries.append(dict(**actual, replacement=str(archive),
                reason='Closed derived token list; input identity and exact canonical fixture/whole held-out source remain available'))
    for name in ('latest-update-main-integrated-control-boundary-root-v1',
                 'latest-update-main-integrated-results-boundary-root-v2'):
        p = B / name / 'record.json'
        v = json.loads(p.read_text())
        assert v['passed'] and v['complete'] and not v['active'] and v['revision']
        for raw in sorted((p.parent / 'staged').rglob('*')):
            if not raw.is_file():
                continue
            target = F / raw.relative_to(p.parent / 'staged')
            actual = identity(raw)
            assert target.is_file() and identity(target)['sha256'] == actual['sha256']
            entries.append(dict(**actual, replacement=str(target),
                reason='Byte-identical staged duplicate of committed and pushed artifact'))
        records[str(p)] = identity(p)['sha256']
    assert len({e['path'] for e in entries}) == len(entries)
    manifest = dict(passed=False, active=True, owner='/root', entries=entries, deleted=[],
                    original_statuses_preserved=True, immutable_receipts=records,
                    named_active_consumers_preserved=['cache512 startup stderr, property stdout/binary/source and all admission inputs',
                        'canonical64K fixture and whole37462 held-out prompt/provenance',
                        'failed publisher1 original receipt and representative secret-scan diagnostic'],
                    reclaimed_logical_bytes=sum(e['bytes'] for e in entries),
                    allocated_blocks_before=sum(Path(e['path']).stat().st_blocks * 512 for e in entries))
    def save():
        manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
    save()
    try:
        for entry in entries:
            p = Path(entry['path'])
            assert identity(p)['sha256'] == entry['sha256']
            assert Path(entry['replacement']).is_file()
            p.unlink()
            manifest['deleted'].append(entry['path'])
        assert all(identity(Path(p))['sha256'] == digest for p, digest in records.items())
        manifest['passed'] = True
    finally:
        manifest['active'] = False
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: manifest[k] for k in ('passed', 'reclaimed_logical_bytes', 'allocated_blocks_before')}))
